hard_invariants: OpenRouter is disabled unless explicitly re-approved.
No discovered upstream code is installed or executed during discovery.
Kimi provider claims require protocol-level evidence from the currently pinned version.
Benchmark claims require reproducible fixtures, warm-up disclosure, hardware identity, and raw results.
Tool-call and MCP compatibility are tested independently from text-generation quality.
No capability promotes itself or silently rewrites shared skills.
Every autonomous evaluation loop has finite time, attempt, cost, and no-progress limits.

evaluation_lanes.purpose: Compare OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic-compatible, and Kimi-native request/response behavior.
Test function calling, MCP tool loops, argument fidelity, bounded retries, and unsupported parameters.
Measure retrieval, instruction retention, contradiction handling, and context compression under increasing load.
Benchmark Windows/Ollama now and preserve a future Apple-Silicon/Rapid-MLX lane without adding a current dependency.
Separate current facts, repository claims, inferred conclusions, and unresolved uncertainty.

approved_patterns: Ferro-style model aliasing and provider capability matrices
Repo Task Proof Loop evidence receipts
Skill Seekers draft generation with mandatory review
SkillClaw candidate diffs without silent production mutation
Rapid-MLX as a future Apple-hardware benchmark only
blocked_patterns: unbounded research while the user sleeps
provider routing based only on advertised model names
anti-detection browser or CAPTCHA bypass behavior
